en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a European hillside religious complex. In the foreground is a small chapel or shrine with a gabled façade topped by a cross, beside a stairway with ornate metal railings leading up through a terraced garden covered in ivy. Behind it stands a larger plastered building with a steep tiled roof, small dormer, and round window. In the background, above the trees, there is a tower with a steep, pointed roof and a large clock face, resembling a church or town clock tower.
